_comment: A filled-in POST /api/a2a/merchant/tasks body — one agent opening a
conversation with the Friends Kitchen merchant.
Note where the coupon code is. It belongs in `data`, never in `message`:
transcribed into prose it is a string a model can mistype, and a mistyped
coupon fails as 'not found' three tool calls later. The merchant is handed
data parts as labelled JSON, exactly as written.
Note also what is absent. There is no budget field and no cash limit. The
merchant learns about the money only if the buyer chooses to bring it up,
and that asymmetry is the point of the exercise.
message: Two zinger burgers and a large drink, take away please. What would that come to?
